title: WantedSMP
description: Everytime you Kill someone you Steal 50% of their Money!
body:
**WantedSMP is a new, unique Minecraft server built around a high-risk Survival Multiplayer experience where your money is your bounty.**

Every time you kill a player, you take 50% of their money, turning PvP into a constant fight for survival and dominance. The more money you have, the bigger the target on your head, creating natural rivalries and nonstop action.

[Trailer](https://www.tiktok.com/@wantedsmp.net/video/7633490432059542817)
